facts.activity_file: working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions

control_failures.control_label: positive communication before approaching mobile equipment
segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: gravity release during a planned shutdown on HT-9004

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment on HT-9004 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating in reduced visibility, specifically working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions. HT-9004 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment had been bypassed. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 7 January 2021 an incident occurred on HT-9004 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during a planned shutdown, releasing gravity energy held as suspended load.
